front_matter:
# L137 Deliverance Ministry International

## Compiled Prophetic Directions & Prayer Manual

**A Ministry Prayer Companion by Pastor Kiky Ocansey**

*L137 stands for Luke 1:37 — "For with God nothing shall be impossible."*

---

### How to use this compilation

This document brings together every prophetic direction, prayer, and declaration Pastor Kiky Ocansey has released across the teachings gathered here, organized by category. Pastor Kiky's original wording is preserved throughout. Full Bible passages are quoted (not just referenced). All "repeat after me," corporate prayer, and declaration language is kept intact.

**The standard L137 deliverance flow** — apply this before any prayer session:

1. Praise and worship
2. Thanksgiving
3. Confession of sins
4. Forgive others
5. Invite the Holy Spirit
6. Teaching (read the section below)
7. Deliverance prayers and declarations
8. Sealing (cover yourself and your household with the blood of Jesus)

**Physical elements** (oil, water, communion, salt) are always framed through Christ's finished work — never as ritual on their own.

---

## Table of Contents

1. [Sealing the Home & Rooms](#1-sealing-the-home--rooms)
2. [Salt / Covenant of Salt](#2-salt--covenant-of-salt)
3. [Spirit Spouse / Spiritual Marriage](#3-spirit-spouse--spiritual-marriage)
4. [Marine & Water Spirits](#4-marine--water-spirits)
5. [Inherited Covenants](#5-inherited-covenants)
6. [Leviathan (Mind Warfare / Pride)](#6-leviathan-mind-warfare--pride)
7. [Evil & Destructive Covenants](#7-evil--destructive-covenants)
8. [Witchcraft Manipulation & Evil Altars](#8-witchcraft-manipulation--evil-altars)
9. [Curses, Spells & Evil Altars (Foundational)](#9-curses-spells--evil-altars-foundational)
10. [Divination & Enchantment](#10-divination--enchantment)
11. [Resurrection Power / Easter](#11-resurrection-power--easter)
12. [Holy Communion / Blood of Jesus Deliverance](#12-holy-communion--blood-of-jesus-deliverance)
13. [Repentance / Clean Heart](#13-repentance--clean-heart)
14. [Scattering Evil Gatherings & Gang-Ups](#14-scattering-evil-gatherings--gang-ups)

---

teachings.title: Anoint Your Room Against Any Snake Spirit
teachings.body:
**Pastor Kiky Ocansey · April 2, 2026**

### Main Scripture

**Genesis 3:15 (KJV)**

> "And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel."

### Prayer — Say:

By the authority in the name of Jesus Christ, and by the power in His blood, I anoint this room and declare by the power of the Holy Ghost.

I consecrate this space unto the Lord God Almighty.

Let the fire of the Holy Ghost fill this room now.

Let the presence of God dwell here permanently In Jesus Name.

Every snake spirit, serpent power, python spirit, cobra spirit, viper spirit, and any crawling spirit assigned to monitor, oppress, choke, poison, manipulate, or hide in this environment, I command you to come out and be destroyed now, in the Name of Jesus.

By the anointing oil, I crush every serpent and scorpion under my feet, according to the word of God.

Any altar, portal, residue, or footprint of the enemy in this room is consumed by Holy Ghost fire now.

**Tonight I declare:**

- This room is covered by the blood of Jesus.
- This room is sealed by the fire of the Holy Ghost.
- No serpent shall rest here in Jesus Name.
- No monitoring spirit shall operate here in Jesus Name.
- No choking, coiling, or silent attacks shall function here by the power of the Holy Ghost.

Lord God Let every hidden work of darkness be exposed and destroyed.

Let the light of God flood this room and chase out all darkness in Jesus Name.

I release the peace of God, the angels of God, and the atmosphere of holiness into this room.

This room is now a dwelling place of the Holy Spirit, a place of rest, prayer, clarity, and divine protection.

I declare that this room is clean, free, protected, and consecrated now and forever in Jesus Name.

**Amen.**

teachings.title: Salt Direction — A Covenant of Salt
teachings.body:
**Pastor Kiky Ocansey**

### Prophetic Action

Put the salt in your bath water, read these scriptures and pray. Bathe with this every day for 3 days.

> Bring to an end all divinations, enchantments, curses and spells against your life, glory and destiny in the name of Jesus.

**Salt works.**

### Scriptures

**Numbers 18:19 (KJV)**

> "All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the LORD, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the LORD unto thee and to thy seed with thee."

**2 Chronicles 13:5 (KJV)**

> "Ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?"

**1 Chronicles 18:12 (KJV)**

> "Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand."

**Leviticus 2:13 (KJV)**

> "And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt."

**Colossians 2:14–15 (KJV)**

> "Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross; And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it."

### Prayer — Say:

Every enchantment into the Sun against my glory and star, expire now by the covenant of salt in Jesus Name.

Every enchantment and divination against my glory and destiny projected in any forest and river, I annul you by the covenant of salt in Jesus Name.

Every spell cast upon my marriage, job, career, health, finance, business and glory be reversed and go back to sender as I wash myself with this salt water in the name of Jesus.

Every charm into the earth against my fruitfulness, expire now in the name of Jesus (Jeremiah 22:29).

Every curse placed in the air against my glory, I destroy by the blood of Jesus and by the covenant of salt in Jesus Name.

All arrows of enchantment, divination, witchcraft and Marine curses enchanted against my life, from before I was born till now, gather yourselves together and go back to your sender in the name of Jesus.

Every legal captivity that I have entered into knowingly or unknowingly Father, set me free by your Mercy and by the covenant of salt in Jesus Name.

**I am free in Jesus Name Amen.**

Bless you all, the Lord is with you in Jesus Name Amen.

teachings.title: Enchantment — Salt Prophetic Direction
teachings.body:
**Pastor Kiky Ocansey**

### Introduction

Take your anointing oil and go outside your house and pray these prayers, and pour the oil on the ground.

### Scriptures

**Numbers 23:23**

> "For there is no sorcery against Jacob, nor any divination against Jacob. It now must be said of Jacob and of Israel, 'Oh what God has done!'"

**Matthew 27:52–53**

> "And the tombs broke open. The bodies of many holy people who had died were raised to life. They came out of the tombs after Jesus's resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared to many people."

**When standing outside, say Revelation 12:16 (KJV):**

> "And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth."

### Prayer at the Doorstep — Say:

O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the Lord. Vomit anything enchanters buried against my life, in the name of Jesus.

Any power calling for my head before evil mirrors, die with the mirror in the name of Jesus.

Herod of my father's house, go back to the Red Sea, in the name of Jesus.

Every power harboring enchantments against me die, in the name of Jesus.

Sun, moon, and stars, vomit every enchantment against my life, in the name of Jesus.

Enchantments, you will not settle down in my life, in the name of Jesus.

Every satanic enchantment done to make me work in error, I deactivate you now by the power in the blood of Jesus Christ, and in the name of Jesus.

Dry bones of my destiny come alive, by the resurrection power of the Lord Jesus Christ, and in the name of Jesus.

I cover and seal all my prayers with the covenant blood of Jesus Christ.

Thank you, Lord, for answered prayers.

### Teaching — Destroying the Spirit of Enchantment in Your Life

My beloved church family, breaking the power of enchantment and divination involves deep spiritual commitment, fervent prayer, and prophetic direction. One of the most effective ways to do this is through the name of Jesus Christ, who has all authority over every power and principality (Philippians 2:9–11).

Beloved, we are encouraged to renounce any involvement in these practices, whether knowingly or unknowingly, and declare Jesus' Lordship over every aspect of your lives.

Beloved, prayers against enchantment and divination should also include asking the Holy Spirit to reveal any hidden areas where such practices might have a hold. It's important to pray for discernment during this prophetic action, and spiritual clarity to identify any spiritual strongholds that need to be broken, in Jesus' name.

### Understanding Salt Spiritually

Modern medical science still uses salt for healing our bodies. The spiritual salt of God heals souls, families, communities, and nations. Salt is for preservation and destruction of principalities and powers.

**2 Chronicles 13:5** — "Should you not know that the Lord God of Israel gave the dominion over Israel to David forever, to him and his sons, by a covenant of salt?"

**1 Chronicles 18:12** — "Moreover, Abishai the son of Zeruiah, slew of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt eighteen thousand."

And also read **Psalm 90:4**.

### The 7-Day Prophetic Action

For the next seven days before you sleep, do the directions of the salt, the water, and the blood of Jesus Christ. Pray and make sure you are speaking directly into the salt, the water, and/or the blood of Jesus. After you have prayed, use the salt water to wash your face, and drink the blood of Jesus before sleeping.

### Prayer Points — Say Aggressively:

Father, I thank you for your protection over my life.

Lord, I come against every enchantment aimed at my life in the name of Jesus.

By the power of the Holy Spirit, I cancel every divination spoken against me.

I declare that no enchantment or divination shall prevail over my family.

Lord, reveal to me any hidden influences of enchantment around me.

In the name of Jesus, I break every curse of enchantment in my lineage.

Holy Spirit, shield me from any form of spiritual manipulation.

Father, I plead the blood of Jesus over every area of my life as protection against divination.

I destroy every spell cast against my health in Jesus's name.

Lord, confuse the plans of those who use enchantments against me.

I declare freedom from every diviner's scheme by the blood of Jesus.

I break free from any spiritual bondages caused by enchantments in Jesus' name.

Father, let your light expose any work of darkness around me.

I reject every prediction from false prophets in Jesus' name.

In the name of Jesus, I cut off every soul tie with practitioners of divination.

Lord, grant me the strength to resist temptations that lead to enchantments.

I declare that I am under God's protection, and no weapon formed against me shall prosper.

I renounce every charm or amulet connected to my name or household.

Holy Spirit, give me the wisdom to discern false spiritual practices.

I plead the blood of Jesus against every familiar spirit sent to monitor me.

Lord, surround me with your divine hedge of protection.

By your power, Lord, cancel every evil prophecy spoken over my life.

I stand firm in my identity in Christ and reject all forms of divination.

Lord, protect my dreams from spiritual attacks through enchantment.

I nullify every effect of divination on my career and finances in Jesus' name.

Father, let your fire consume all enchantments and spells targeted at me.

I declare that my home is a sanctuary for God's presence, free from all occult practices.

### Closing Declaration

As I wash my face with this salt water and drink the blood of Jesus, I declare my freedom from every spirit of enchantments in my life and in my destiny, in Jesus' mighty name. **Amen. I am free.**

Beloved, prayers against enchantment and divination are vital for maintaining spiritual purity and protection. By rejecting occult practices and calling on the power of Jesus, beloved, you can break free from the spiritual bonds that seek to control your lives. These prayers and prophetic actions bring peace, restoration, and a renewed focus on God's truth, ensuring that no form of spiritual manipulation can prosper. Always remember, as Numbers 23:23 reminds us, that no enchantment or divination can succeed against those who belong to God. **Amen. Blessings to you all.**

teachings.title: Spirit Spouse Directions — 21-Night Prophetic Action
teachings.body:
**Pastor Kiky Ocansey · October 29, 2025**

### Prophetic Action

Take your anointing oil and the blood of Jesus, say this prayer, every night before you sleep.

Mark yourself, including your private parts, with the blood of Jesus.

Also drink the blood, anoint yourself with the oil.

Anoint your ring finger and remove any invisible wedding rings from your fingers.

Do this every night for 21 days before you sleep. Some of you can continue even further as the Holy Ghost leads.

Remember to share your encounters and dreams.

### Scriptures

**Matthew 22:29–30 (NLT)**

> "Jesus replied, 'Your mistake is that you don't know the Scriptures, and you don't know the power of God. For when the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage. In this respect they will be like the angels in heaven.'"

**Isaiah 54:5 (KJV)**

> "For thy Maker is thine husband; the LORD of hosts is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called."

**Exodus 12:13 (KJV)**

> "And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt."

### Prayer — Say:

Let the counsel of God prosper in my life.

By the blood of Jesus, I destroy the power of any demonic seed in my life from the womb.

By the blood of Jesus, I speak unto my umbilical gate to overthrow all negative parental spirits.

By the blood of Jesus, I break the yoke of the spirit having access to my reproductive gates.

By the blood of Jesus, O Lord, let your time of refreshing come upon me.

I bring fire from the altar of the Lord upon every evil marriage by the blood of Jesus.

I redeem myself by the blood of Jesus from every sex trap.

In the name of Jesus, I erase the engraving of my name on any evil marriage record.

In the name of Jesus, I reject and renounce every evil spiritual marriage.

In the name of Jesus, I confess that Yeshua is my original spouse and is jealous over me by the blood of Jesus.

I issue a bill of divorcement to every spirit wife, husband, in the name of Yeshua.

I bind every spirit wife, husband with everlasting chains in the name of Jesus.

Let heavenly testimony overcome every evil testimony of hell, in the name of Jesus.

O Lord, bring to my remembrance every spiritual trap and contract; let the blood of Jesus purge me of every contaminating material, in the name of Jesus.

Let the spirit husband, spirit wife fall down and die in Jesus' name.

Let all your children attached to me fall down and die in the name of Jesus.

I burn your certificates and destroy your rings.

As I anoint my ring finger, I execute judgment against water spirits and declare that you are reserved for everlasting chains and darkness in the name of Jesus.

O Lord, contend with those who are contending with me.

Every trademark of water spirit, be shaken out of my life in the name of Jesus.

As I mark my private part with the blood of Jesus, I stand on Exodus 12:13 that when the spirit wife, husbands see the blood of Jesus, they will pass over me and will not bring any plague upon my life and destiny in Jesus' name.

**Amen. I am free by the power of the Holy Ghost. Amen.**

Now you can sleep with the protection of God in Jesus' mighty name. **Amen.** Waiting for your testimonies.

### Main Scripture

**Psalm 140:1–4 (KJV)**

> "Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man; which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war. They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah. Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings."

I break every covenant made knowingly or unknowingly with marine spirits in Jesus' name.

By the blood of Jesus, I nullify every agreement between me and marine spirits.

I command every marine spirit operating in my life to be destroyed by the fire of the Holy Ghost.

I reject every manipulation from marine spirits over my health in the name of Jesus.

Holy Ghost fire, consume every marine spirit influencing my thoughts and decisions.

Lord, release Your judgment upon every marine spirit holding me in bondage.

Every marine spirit assigned to destroy my destiny, I command you to perish in the name of Jesus.

I release myself from the grip of any marine queen or king operating in the waters.

I command all marine spirits to flee from my life and my family in Jesus' name.

I take authority over every marine spirit trying to control my relationships and break their hold in Jesus' name.

By the blood of Jesus, I sever every tie between my ancestors and marine spirits.

Lord, let Your angels go forth and bind every marine spirit hindering my breakthrough.

teachings.title: Destroying Every Inherited Covenant
teachings.body:
**Pastor Kiky Ocansey · Clubhouse · December 20, 2025**

### Prophetic Action

Every day or night, take the blood of Jesus and pray these prayers, drink the blood of Jesus.

Anoint your umbilical cord with the blood of Jesus.

Do this for however many days or nights as the Holy Ghost leads you.

**Remember to hold your umbilical cord while praying.**

### Scriptures

**Luke 22:20 (KJV)**

> "Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you."

**Hebrews 12:24 (KJV)**

> "And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel."

**Ezekiel 16:1–6 (KJV)**

> "Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying, Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations, And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of Canaan; thy father was an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite. And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all. None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born. And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live."

🩸 I speak destruction unto the fruits of unclean spirits in my life, in the name of Jesus.

🩸 I break every evil covenant link, by the blood of Jesus.

🩸 I dismantle every stronghold of evil blood covenants, by the blood of Jesus.

🩸 I nullify the effects of evil access to my blood, by the blood of Jesus.

🩸 I release myself from every covenanted-curse, by the blood of Jesus.

🩸 I release every organ in my body from the grip of evil blood covenant, by the blood of Jesus.

🩸 I dissociate myself and my family from every territorial blood covenant, by the blood of Jesus.

🩸 I dissociate myself from every tribal blood covenant, by the blood of Jesus.

🩸 I dissociate myself from every inherited blood covenant, by the blood of Jesus.

🩸 I withdraw my blood from every evil altar, in the name of Jesus.

🩸 I release myself from every curse, attached to evil covenants, in the name of Jesus.

🩸 I release myself from the grip of curse-covenant breakers, in the name of Jesus.

🩸 Every repercussion of breaking unconscious covenants, be washed away by the blood of Jesus.

🩸 As I mark myself with the blood and I drink the blood of Jesus, Lord set me free from all evil covenants in Jesus Name.

🩸 As I drink the blood of Jesus cause a blood transfusion in my body, and set me free from any inherited battles from my mother's and my father's side in Jesus Name. **Amen.**

**Now drink the blood of Jesus, anoint your umbilical cord and have peaceful sleep. Amen.**

teachings.title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan
teachings.body:
**Pastor Kiky Ocansey · April 11, 2026**

### Inviting the Holy Spirit

We invite the Holy Spirit to come and take full control over our service. We call upon the Holy Spirit to lead us in our prayers tonight. Holy Spirit, teach us what to pray tonight. We invite the Spirit of the Lord in this room, in the mighty name of Jesus. We ask that His angels will ascend and descend in this place tonight. We ask that His fire surround us, in the mighty name of Jesus.

We come against any interference, any destruction, every agenda of the wicked. We come against it by the power of the Holy Ghost. We pray that the fire of the Lord saturates this room, that the presence of the Lord fills this room.

Let the protection of the Lord be upon us — that every power assigned to hinder this meeting or to hinder our deliverance or prayer, in the mighty name of Jesus, be destroyed by the power of the Holy Ghost. Every voice of the enemy be silenced in the midst of our praise. We declare that this meeting is covered by the blood of Jesus. We rebuke every retaliation to this prayer and to this deliverance in the mighty name of Jesus. Father, have Your way tonight. We give You all the glory in the mighty name of Jesus. Thank You, Father. In Jesus' name we have prayed, **Amen.**

### Thanksgiving

We come with a heart of gratitude because we are well, we are fit, we can see. The Bible says in **Psalm 100:4 (KJV)**: *"Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name."* Our thanksgiving is like a spiritual key. When we thank God, He activates His presence. He secures His protection over us. He multiplies His provision around us.

Beloved, our going out and our coming in — we give Him thanks and praise for keeping us, for watching over our family, our children.

Let us read **Psalm 103:1–22 (KJV)** together as a family:

> "Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name. Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases; Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies; Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's. The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed. He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel. The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy. He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever. He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities. For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him. As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us. Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him. For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust. As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth. For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more. But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children; To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them. The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all. Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word. Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his that do his pleasure. Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul."

### Invitation of the Holy Ghost

Tonight it is not by power, not by might, but by My Spirit, saith the LORD (**Zechariah 4:6 KJV**):

> "Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts."

Deliverance is not a human activity. It is the Holy Ghost's operation. It is the Holy Ghost's power. It is the Holy Ghost that touches you.

The fresh move of the Holy Ghost — we invite Him to come and take full control over this deliverance prayer, over our atmosphere, over your houses. In the mighty name of Jesus, let the Holy Ghost silence any other entity. Silence any adverse spirit. Silence any serpent spirit, Leviathan spirit. Let the Holy Ghost fight every entity that is fighting your life. In the mighty name of Jesus, we call upon the Spirit of the Lord to come and lead our prayers tonight, to come and direct our word, our action, our declarations. We call upon the fire of the Holy Ghost to fall upon this place, to fill our atmosphere.

### Main Scripture — Job 41:1–11 (KJV)

> "Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down? Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn? Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee? Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever? Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens? Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants? Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears? Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more. Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him? None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me? Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine."

### Teaching — Recognizing the Spirit of Leviathan

The spirit of Leviathan leads to quarrels, separation, and isolation. He operates in marriages, twisting communications, causing accusations and misunderstanding. Between friends, even at the workplace. The spirit of Leviathan destroys marriages and friendships.

Beloved, by the time you realize it, every friend you have a problem with, every man you have a problem with, every woman you are arguing with — there is always some misunderstanding. It gets to a point in the relationship where something happens. You will know when you have encountered this type of discouragement in your life.

Discern the presence of these water spirits and become equipped with spiritual warfare strategy to defeat them in the mighty name of Jesus. Otherwise, people might look at you funny. People might say you have mental health issues. People might say you are quarrelsome, argumentative, annoying — because when these spirits attack you, you are not aware. You cannot control your anger.

The spirit of Leviathan is not an ordinary spirit. It is a marine spirit, a serpentine spirit, a twisting power. In many deliverance settings it is known to operate through pride, arrogance, twisting of words, misunderstanding, and confusion.

Leviathan is a powerful, stubborn, and untouchable spirit without divine intervention. In **Isaiah 27:1 (KJV)**:

> "In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea."

God Himself fights and destroys the spirit of Leviathan from your life. Beloved, this spirit twists the meaning of words and seeks to destroy the unity of people.

**How to recognize it:**
- It works to hinder your spiritual growth. You are in church every day, you are reading the Bible, but you cannot understand anything. You cannot pray. You feel tormented when you take the Bible.
- It fosters an atmosphere of accusation against you at all times.
- Many people link this spirit to insomnia and challenges with focus.

**Its purpose:** This spirit will try to destroy you and make you fall into sin. It will hinder your prayer life. It tries to make you fall asleep while reading the Bible. It will not allow you to submit to those in authority because it works through the spirit of pride. In many marriages we have found the spirit of Leviathan operating to cause separation and divorce.

This is the spirit after some men or women who will beat you to the point that you are dying — your face swollen — and later they say something took over them; they went blank, the spirit took over. This spirit can make you angry. Some people have religious anger that cannot be controlled — that is the spirit of Leviathan.

**Proverbs 16:18 (KJV)**:

> "Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall."

There will be hindrances that stop you from receiving deliverance from Leviathan: sin, ungodly soul ties, occultism, fear, embarrassment, unbelief, unclean spirits on saved souls, unforgiveness, lack of knowledge, and rejection. Some people will not receive deliverance from Leviathan because his kingdom is protected by his scales.

Leviathan is an oppression, a spirit of pride. You find it so difficult to say "I am wrong" so that you can apologize and move on. You have a sickness that moves when receiving prayer — you ask for prayer for your back and the pain shifts to another part of your body. The migraine is gone but now you have a stomach pain. The stomach pain is gone, but now you have a severe back pain. You believe you are healed but the ailment returns repeatedly.

When you are delivered from this spirit, it becomes easier to read the Bible and stay awake during services. Healing and relief of pain is your portion. If this spirit leaves your household, you and your partner, your children become at peace. A lot of families that are not talking to one another, a lot of families in argument — it is this spirit that operates in them.

### Deliverance Prayer & Declarations

**Take your communion wine — if you don't have communion wine, take a cup of water — and prepare your anointing oil.**

I cover your body, your soul and your spirit with the blood of Jesus. Let every legal ground of Leviathan's spirit be destroyed now over your destiny.

Every spirit of Leviathan hiding in your body, hiding in your blood, hiding in your organs, hiding in your system, hiding in your foundation — I command it to come out now. We command it out of your system. We command it out of your foundation. We command it out of your mind. We command it out of your body. We command it out of your atmosphere in the name of Jesus Christ.

Anoint your household. Every spirit of Leviathan operating in my atmosphere, operating in my room — walk into your marital room, anoint that place. Every spirit of Leviathan that has caused disunity, that has caused division, that has caused misunderstanding — Lord Jesus, as I anoint my matrimonial room, I destroy this spirit. I cast it out of my house. I cast it out of my ceiling. I cast it out of my tiles. I cast it out of my walls in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Go into your children's room, do the same thing. We are casting out this spirit.

May the Lord forgive every sin on this platform and begin His mighty deliverance in our life and in our destiny.

### Repeat After Me — Renunciation Prayer

**As you hold your water and your communion, say:**

Blood of Jesus.

Settle my case tonight.

Every strange spirit, every strange spirit — trouble in my blood, causing confusion and disgrace — be destroyed by the blood of Jesus.

Every problem I acquired as a result of Leviathan spirits, by the blood of Jesus, completely search them out.

By the power of the Holy Ghost, I call them out tonight.

I am free from inherited foundational battles.

I declare my victory in the name of Jesus.

**Renunciations — say:**

I renounce the spirit of pride and arrogance.

I renounce self-centeredness, self-righteousness.

I renounce every spirit of rejection.

I renounce every lion spirit now.

I renounce anger from my life.

I renounce rebellion from my life.

I renounce heaviness from my life.

I renounce the spirit of lust from my life.

I renounce every arrogance from my life.

I renounce witchcraft and anger from my life.

I renounce manipulation and rage from my life.

I renounce every hard-hearted spirit from my life.

I renounce mockery, rebellion from my life.

I renounce shame and arrogance from my life.

I renounce control and disobedience from my life.

Lord, set me free now in the name of Jesus.

Lord, deliver me in the mighty name of Jesus.

I claim the blood of Jesus.

Cast out these spirits from my life now in the name of Jesus.

I renounce every boasting spirit from my life.

I renounce every lying spirit from my life.

I renounce every stubbornness from my life.

I renounce unwillingness to apologize from my life.

I renounce all the evil spirits that have been in my life.

I bring the blood of Jesus. I command you to loose me and let me go now.

I will vomit you out.

I command by the Holy Ghost, I say, "Bring the blood of Jesus."

I cast you out of my mind.

I cast you out of my mouth.

I cast you out of my skin.

I cast you out of my private parts.

I cast you out of any spiritual, physical openings.

You in your doorways, I shut it by the blood of Jesus.

### Personal Renunciation

Before you drink the blood, if you yourself have anything in your heart that you want to renounce — anger, disobedience, things that you know are there — by the power of the Holy Ghost, if you feel like any serpent is operating in your life, aspects of Leviathan, any pride — begin to mention it yourself and renounce them out of your life now. This is between you and God.

**Say:**

I renounce that rebellion spirit and heaviness — Lord Jesus, it is all connected to Leviathan. I renounce it, Father.

That twisting spirit, twisting my words — I renounce it.

That serpent that keeps whispering in my ears — I renounce you.

I renounce that shame, that rebellion, that arrogance that is in me. I renounce it, Lord. I don't want it, Father. Forgive me. I renounce it.

**Amen.**

**By air or liquid, come out of me.**

### Drink the Blood of Jesus

As I drink the blood of Jesus — you, this spirit that has caused brokenness in my marriage; you, this spirit that has caused my household to be in disunity; you, this spirit that has caused my family, everybody against each other; you, this spirit that is operating in my family — I renounce you. I denounce you. I destroy you out of my life in the name of Jesus Christ. I cast you out. I vomit you out.

In the name of Jesus, I command you to come out now. In the name of Jesus, I command you to come out now. In the name of Jesus, I command you to come out now.

Every spirit of division operating from your foundation, your mother's side, your father's side, that has caused chaos in your life — I command by the power of the Holy Ghost, let it come out now. In the name of Jesus, come out. Every spirit that has caused disunity, let it come out.

Let the fire of the Holy Ghost touch you from the head to the soles of your feet. In the mighty name of Jesus, I speak deliverance. Every Leviathan spirit, by the power of the Holy Ghost, I command it out now. We bind it out. All over your body, come out. The one in your stomach — come out in the name of Jesus. Hold your stomach. Every Leviathan spirit, serpent spirit, marine spirit, come out of your stomach right now. Vomit it out.

### Deliverance Declaration — Say:

Father, in the name of Jesus, I come to you now as my deliverer. You know the torment that I have experienced from spiritual strongholds in my life, and I recognize that You alone have the power to deliver me.

Blood of Jesus, I have just drunk. And I take authority over the spirit of Leviathan. I take authority with the Spirit of the fire, Father.

I command that spirit of pride — come out in Jesus' name.

I command the spirit of ignorance to come out of me now.

I declare that through the shed blood of the Lamb of Jesus, the light has gone into my life.

And every demonic stronghold in my life, I renounce. It is broken now in the name of Jesus.

Lord, deliver me tonight by the power of the Holy Ghost. Set me free now in the name of Jesus.

The chains around my neck, be removed. The chains around my feet, be removed. The chains around my hands, be removed.

Father, forgive me for any area I have missed — especially for disobedience and pride in my life — whether knowingly or unknowingly.

In the mighty name of Jesus, I declare by faith that tonight I am completely and totally free.

By the power of the Holy Ghost, I destroy and cast out. I bind every arrogant demon from my life. I destroy all negative energy and demonic spirits from my life. I command you by the blood of Jesus, out of me now — by air or liquid, out of me now — by every opening of my body.

I bind and displace every sea monster that would attack my life.

Tonight by the blood — lay your hands on your stomach — tonight by the blood, I command every spirit of bondage to come out. Every spirit of fear, come out.

Be delivered in the name of Jesus. If this spirit has tormented your home, be delivered. Your children, be delivered by the power of the Holy Ghost.

By the blood of Jesus, I crush the head of every tormenting spirit in your way tonight.

By the blood of Jesus, I sprinkle the blood of Jesus on all your properties right now. Let the blood of Jesus dry up Leviathan spirit, Leviathan attack. In your mind, let the blood of Jesus break demonic spells. In the name of Jesus, we block this curse of Leviathan to destroy your mind.

### Python Spirit — Additional Deliverance

Right now, in the name of Jesus, I command every python spirit to come out — vomit it out. If your stomach is hurting you, hold your stomach. The Holy Ghost will touch your stomach. A burning sensation from the Holy Ghost will burn out every serpent, every python spirit in your stomach. Come out now in the name of Jesus. Burn it out. In the name of Jesus, come out. Holy Ghost fire will burn you out.

### Closing Sealing

I bind and I create a boundary against every problem in your life by the blood.

I plead the blood of Jesus against any Leviathan spirit and against any evil spirit working against you.

**Be revived now — to your life, to your spirit, to your body — be revived now in the name of Jesus.**

**Amen.**

teachings.title: Destroying Evil & Destructive Covenants — Warfare / Prophetic Directions (Part 1)
teachings.body:
**Pastor Kiky Ocansey · Clubhouse · May 23, 2026**

### Scripture

**Isaiah 28:18 (KJV)**

> "And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it."

### Prophetic Action

If you have the communion wine, take it right now in the mighty name of Jesus. We are going to stand on Isaiah 28:18. And your covenant with death shall be disannulled by the blood. And your agreement with hell shall not stand by the blood.

**Take the blood of Jesus.**

### Repeat This Prayer — Say:

You are going to drink the blood. Say this prayer.

Holy Spirit, even if I cannot remember any agreement, any covenant I have made, in the mighty name of Jesus, tonight, fight it for me. Disconnect me. Those agreements cannot stand. It cannot stand anymore in my life. It cannot distract my life. It cannot send me backwards. It cannot bring me disappointment.

Any agreement, covenant with sorrow — Lord, I cancel it tonight. Any covenant with tears — I cancel it tonight. Covenant with poverty — I cancel it. Wherever it's coming from, Lord, in the mighty name of Jesus.

Pick up your communion wine. If you don't have communion wine, pick up the blood.

Believe that you are disconnecting yourself. Whatever covenant — the ones I can't remember, my own relationships — Lord Jesus, I'm in trouble in my marriage. I'm in trouble in my finances. The water in your hands is sanctified for me by the blood of Jesus.

Father, touch me tonight and deliver me. In the name of Jesus, agreements and contracts, covenants that I went into with ex-boyfriends, ex-husbands, ex-wives, women I dated, men I dated — Lord Jesus, I set the word in agreement with them, but now I am no more with them, and I cannot move forward. I cannot have my peace. There are certain soul ties that are hanging on my life. Lord Jesus, I break every agreement, every contract I have with these old exes that have become a destructive covenant in my life. Set me free. My life needs to move forward in every area of my life.

I renounce every evil oath I have with these people, every evil vow, vows that I said, things that I said when I was with them, promises I made in agreement, even through sex that signifies blood covenant.

Deliver me, Lord. Deliver me. Deliver me.

Now, as you hold the blood of Jesus, you speak the words directly into the cup you are holding in the mighty name of Jesus. This is Part 1. We will do Part 2 on Monday. Speak minutes that you want freedom. Speak minutes that you want to be delivered. Speak minutes that you want to cancel every covenant, agreement, contract by the power of the Holy Ghost.

**Say:**

As I drink the blood of Jesus, I break every contract. I disconnect myself from every contract.

*(Repeat.)*

**Now drink the blood.** After you finish drinking, sing worship before we continue.

### Corporate Prayer — Say:

Let the blood of Jesus heal every hidden curse in your life by the blood right now.

Every covenant of financial struggle, let it be destroyed by the blood.

Every covenant connected to evil sacrifices, by the blood, let the blood destroy it.

Every covenant speaking of no progress in your life, let the blood of Jesus destroy it.

Destiny, arise and shine again.

Every invisible assignment be consumed by the fire, by the blood of Jesus.

Let the blood of Jesus establish divine liberty in your life.

Be delivered from every contract, covenant that was made on your behalf by the blood.

Let the blood of Jesus destroy every divine covenant working against your life.

By the power of the Holy Spirit, cleanse my life, cleanse my organs, cleanse my body, everything affected in my life with the toxic covenant. Lord, set me free tonight in the mighty name of Jesus.

I break and loose you from every collective evil covenant you are facing right now in your life by the power of the Holy Spirit.

From every evil proof that was made when you were a child — an agreement, a covenant that was made in your innocence — let strong men that are attacking your life be paralyzed from tonight.

Any agreement you went into with an ex-partner, tonight we destroy it by the power of the Holy Ghost.

Any rod of the wicked that is rising up against you and your family right now, we destroy it, we set it on fire in the name of Jesus.

I cancel every consequence of any evil local name attached to your person by the power of the Holy Ghost.

Every effect of demonic covenant, come out of your life. If demonic covenant brought you demonic marriage, come out of my life.

### Say — "Come Out of My Life":

Say: demonic institution — come out of my life.

Say: laying of evil hands — come out of my life.

Say: wrong exposure to sex — come out of my life.

Say: fellowship with local idols — come out of my life.

Say: evil dedication — I uproot you out of my life.

Say: every inherited infirmity — I command you to come out of my life.

Say: I command you to come out of my life.

Say: demonic blood incisions — come out of my life.

Say: every parental curse that came through covenants, break by fire right now in the name of Jesus.

I uproot every demonic sacrifice.

I destroy every dream pollution.

Every demonic initiation, I cancel it by the fire of the Holy Ghost.

I refuse to drink from the fountains of sorrow.

I took authority over all curses pronounced over my life.

God, remove every cast placed over my life.

I cancel every curse pronounced against my life. I cancel every curse pronounced against my life. Let every demon attached to any curse in my life depart right now, in the name of Jesus.

**All curses issued against me be converted to blessings in the name of Jesus.**

### Break, Break, Break by Fire

**When each item is mentioned, say: "Break. Break. Break by fire."**

Every curse of mental and physical sickness — **Break. Break. Break by the fire of the Holy Ghost.**

Every curse of failure — **Break. Break. Break by fire.**

*(Continue in this pattern for every curse the Lord brings to your remembrance.)*

We cast out every sickness in my life. Every class of sickness and infirmity in my life — in the mighty name of Jesus.

### Anoint Yourself — Blessing Declaration

**Now take your oil. You now place blessings on yourself in the name of Jesus. As you anoint yourself:**

There shall be no more poverty.

There shall be no more sickness.

There shall be no more evil dedication.

You shall be obedient to the blessings upon yourself.

As I anoint myself with this oil, in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I rebuke you from every body, every evil.

Every hidden altar, be destroyed in your life. Anything done against your life under the demonic anointing, let it be demolished.

**In Jesus Name. Amen.**

teachings.title: Deliverance from Witchcraft Manipulation & Attacks (Part A — At the Ground with the Blood of Jesus)
teachings.body:
**Pastor Kiky Ocansey · Clubhouse · April 29, 2026**

### Scriptures

**Jeremiah 22:29 (KJV)**

> "O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the LORD."

**Revelation 12:16 (KJV)**

> "And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth."

> "He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly."

📌 O earth, vomit out every evil sacrifice buried against my life, by the blood of Jesus.

📌 Any power using the dust, soil, sand, or ground to manipulate my destiny, die by fire, in Jesus Name.

📌 Every witchcraft attack programmed into the ground against my footsteps, be destroyed by the blood of Jesus.

📌 O earth, refuse to cooperate with my enemies, in the Name of Jesus.

📌 Every evil altar raised from the ground against my progress, catch fire now, in Jesus Name.

📌 By the blood of Jesus, I silence every voice crying from the earth against my life.

📌 O earth, open your mouth and swallow every witchcraft arrow sent against me.

📌 Every evil seed planted in the ground to control my life, be uprooted by Holy Ghost fire.

📌 I recover my destiny from every witchcraft manipulation, by the blood of Jesus.

📌 O earth, carry my blessings and reject my battles, in Jesus Name.

📌 As I pour this blood on the earth, every curse released upon the ground because of me, be broken now by the blood of Jesus.

📌 I command every wicked foundation speaking through the earth against me to be silenced forever by the blood of Jesus.

📌 By the blood of Jesus, I declare total deliverance from witchcraft manipulation and attacks.

📌 The earth is the Lord's, and the fullness thereof.

📌 Therefore, no witch, no wizard, no evil altar, no familiar spirit, no household enemy, and no power of darkness shall use the earth against me.

teachings.title: Witchcraft Manipulation & Attacks (Part B — Evil Altars & the Four Altars of Abraham)
teachings.body:
**Pastor Kiky Ocansey · Clubhouse · April 29, 2026**

### Prayer — As I Pour This Oil or the Blood of Jesus on the Earth:

Lord, destroy every evil altar against my life in Jesus Name.

Every evil altar my parent have dedicated me to, I command that altar to catch fire now in Jesus name.

Evil family altar holding on to my virtues, release my virtue and die in Jesus name.

As I pour the blood of Jesus on this earth, demons attached to my life from that evil family altar — what are you waiting for? Die in Jesus name.

Every power that has circulated my name on evil altar, fall down and die in Jesus name.

Let fire of God fall upon every human altar fashioned against me, in the name of Jesus.

As I pour the blood of Jesus, every human altar drinking my blood, be bound, in the name of Jesus.

I break and destroy every human altar working against my life, in the name of Jesus.

Let the strength of the human altar in my family be broken, in the name of Jesus.

I withdraw by fire everything programmed into the heavenlies against me by human altars, in the name of Jesus.

By this blood on the earth, every tree altar of witches in my compound, fall down and die, in the name of Jesus.

Every tree idol in my compound, fall down and die, in the name of Jesus.

I withdraw every sacrifice given to tree altars on my behalf, in the name of Jesus.

### Raising Altars with the Blood of Jesus

From today, my Father, I raise an altar with the blood of Jesus against any demonic junction where my glory have been sacrificed to, in the name of Jesus.

O Lord, I raise an altar with the blood of Jesus against demonic curses, covenants, limitations, evil foundations and disorder in my destiny today, release by fire, in the name of Jesus.

My Father, I raise an altar with the blood of Jesus against the altar of darkness militating against my health, in the name of Jesus.

I raise an altar with the blood of Jesus against any demonic altar, in Jesus Name.

### I Build the Four Altars of Abraham Now

**1. An Altar of Praise — Genesis 12:1–7 (KJV)**

> "Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed. So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran. And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came. And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land. And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him."

**2. An Altar of Prayer — Genesis 12:8–13 (KJV)**

> "And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD. And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south. And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land. And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive. Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee."

**3. An Altar of Peace — Genesis 13:14–18 (KJV)**

> "And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever. And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered. Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee. Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD."

**4. An Altar of Provision — Genesis 22:9–14 (KJV)**

> "And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood. And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son. And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I. And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me. And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son. And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen."

**IN JESUS NAME. AMEN.**

### And Read:

**Psalm 94:1 (KJV)**

> "O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself."

teachings.body:
**Pastor Kiky Ocansey · Clubhouse · May 6, 2026**

### Scriptures

**Matthew 27:52–53**

> "And the tombs broke open. The bodies of many holy people who had died were raised to life. They came out of the tombs after Jesus' resurrection and went into the holy city and appeared to many people."

**Numbers 23:23**

> "For there is no sorcery against Jacob, nor any divination against Israel. It now must be said of Jacob and of Israel, 'Oh, what God has done!'"

🙏 O earth, earth, earth, hear the Word of the Lord — vomit anything enchanters buried against my life, in the name of Jesus.

🙏 Any power calling for my head before evil mirrors, die with the mirror, in the name of Jesus.

teachings.title: Breaking Soul Ties — Holy Communion, Deliverance & Covenant Sealing
teachings.body:
**Pastor Kiky Ocansey · December 22, 2025**

This Holy Communion is taken as a faith action, representing the Blood of Jesus Christ and the New Covenant, for the purpose of breaking ungodly soul ties, evil covenants, and spiritual oppression.

### Instruction

If you have communion wine, you may use it. If not, you may use water or anointing oil as a point of faith.

**The communion represents:**

- The Blood of Jesus Christ
- The New Covenant
- Redemption, cleansing, and deliverance

Faith without action is dead. Take this moment seriously and prayerfully.

### Scripture Foundation

**Luke 22:20 (KJV)**

> "Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you."

**Hebrews 12:24 (KJV)**

> "And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel."

### Holy Communion Prayer — Said Aloud

**As you hold the communion element, pray:**

- By the power of the Holy Spirit and by the blood of Jesus, as I take this communion, remove and cleanse from my life and destiny every evil covenant and ungodly soul tie.

- By the blood of Jesus, wash away every witchcraft writing, spiritual pollution, and demonic agreement affecting my spirit, soul, and body.

- As I drink the blood of Jesus, I submit my affections, emotions, desires, and will to the Holy Spirit.

- By this communion, I break every covenant with past relationships, relatives, and ungodly connections.

- I renounce every ungodly covenant with the living or the dead that is haunting my life or destiny.

- By the blood of Jesus, I disconnect from every sexual, emotional, or spiritual agreement formed knowingly or unknowingly.

- I establish a new covenant with Christ Jesus alone.

- Let every verdict of wickedness spoken over my life be reversed by the blood of Jesus.

- Let every limitation introduced through ungodly soul ties be destroyed now by the blood of Jesus.

### Action

**Now drink the communion in faith.**

As you do, declare:

- By the blood of Jesus, I claim my complete deliverance.
- I am redeemed by the blood of Jesus.
- I am free from every ungodly soul tie and evil covenant.

### Sealing Declaration

- By the blood of Jesus, every door opened through ungodly relationships is now closed.
- Every effect of past covenants is terminated.
- My destiny, glory, and progress are restored.
- I walk in freedom, peace, and alignment with Christ.

### Closing Scripture

**John 8:36 (KJV)**

> "If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed."

teachings.title: Psalm 51 — A Prayer of Repentance
teachings.body:
**A Psalm of David when Nathan the prophet went to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.**

### Psalm 51:1–19 (NKJV)

> Have mercy upon me, O God, according to Your lovingkindness; according to the multitude of Your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions. Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin. For I acknowledge my transgressions, and my sin is always before me. Against You, You only, have I sinned, and done this evil in Your sight, that You may be found just when You speak, and blameless when You judge. Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity, and in sin my mother conceived me. Behold, You desire truth in the inward parts, and in the hidden part You will make me to know wisdom. Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow. Make me hear joy and gladness, that the bones You have broken may rejoice. Hide Your face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities. Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me. Do not cast me away from Your presence, and do not take Your Holy Spirit from me. Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and uphold me by Your generous Spirit. Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners shall be converted to You. Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation, and my tongue shall sing aloud of Your righteousness. O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth shall show forth Your praise. For You do not desire sacrifice, or else I would give it; You do not delight in burnt offering. The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit, a broken and a contrite heart. These, O God, You will not despise. Do good in Your good pleasure to Zion; build the walls of Jerusalem. Then You shall be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering; then they shall offer bulls on Your altar.

### Reflection on Psalm 51:1–19

This Psalm expresses one of the clearest examples of repentance in all of Scripture. Countless broken sinners have found in these words an exquisite expression of their deeply felt need for God's mercy and forgiveness. David's confession has helped people examine excuses, half-hearted repentance, and lack of sorrow over sin that can keep them from experiencing pardon. David's words also demonstrate the place of hope within confession. Use this Psalm as a starting point when guilt or a feeling of distance from God is affecting your relationship with Him. It will help you identify and remove sin in your life through sincere confession and repentance.

### On Verses 1–7

David was truly sorry for his adultery with Bathsheba and for murdering her husband to cover it up. He knew that his actions had hurt many people. Because David repented of those sins, God mercifully forgave him. No sin is too great to be forgiven. Do you feel that you could never come close to God because you have done something terrible? God can and will forgive you of any sin if you ask Him to and turn from it. He will cleanse and purify you. While God forgives us, however, He does not always erase the natural consequences of our sin. David's life and family were never the same as a result of what he had done. See **2 Samuel 12:1–23**.

### On Verse 4

Although his sin had been against Bathsheba and Uriah, David said that he had sinned against God. When someone steals, murders, or slanders, the act is against someone else, a victim. According to the world's standards, extramarital sex between two consenting adults is acceptable if nobody gets hurt, but people do get hurt. In David's case, a man was murdered and a baby died. All sin hurts us and others, but ultimately it offends God because sin in any form is rebellion against His way of living. When you are tempted to do wrong, remember that you will be sinning against God. That may help you avoid disaster.

### On Verse 10

Because we are born as sinners (**51:5**), we naturally want to please ourselves rather than God. David followed that inclination when he took another man's wife. We also follow it when we sin in any way. Like David, we must ask God to cleanse us from within (**51:7**), clearing our hearts and spirits for new thoughts and desires. Godly conduct can come only from a clean heart and spirit. Ask God to create a clean heart and spirit in you.

### On Verse 12

Do you ever feel stagnant in your faith, as though you are just going through the motions? Has sin ever driven a wedge between you and God, making Him seem distant? David felt this way. He had sinned with Bathsheba and had just been confronted by Nathan the prophet. In his prayer he cried, "Restore to me the joy of Your salvation." God wants us to be close to Him and to experience His full and complete life, but sin that remains unconfessed makes such intimacy impossible. Confess your sin to God. You may still have to face earthly consequences, as David did, but God will return the joy of your relationship with Him.

### On Verse 13

When God forgives our sin and restores our relationship with Him, we want to reach out to others who need this forgiveness and reconciliation. The more you have felt God's forgiveness, the more you will desire to tell others about it. Encourage someone today with the reassurance that God loves and forgives him or her.

### On Verse 17

God wants a broken spirit and repentant heart. You can never please God by outward actions, no matter how good, if your inward heart attitude resists Him. Are you sorry for your sin? Do you genuinely intend to stop? Brokenness here is about being open and responsive to God's correction, as opposed to being hardened or resentful. God is pleased by this kind of humble repentance.

teachings.title: Destroying Every Evil Gang-Up and Gathering Against My Life and Progress
teachings.body:
**Pastor Kiky Ocansey · July 29, 2026**

### Prophetic Action

Take your anointing oil and the blood of Jesus, go outside, pray this prayer, and pour the oil and the blood of Jesus on the ground.

### Main Scripture

**Isaiah 8:10 (KJV)**

> "Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us."

### Prayer — Say:

Father, I ask that as I come to You this day in prayer, scatter every evil gathering against me and my entire household, in the name of Jesus.

Father, as I pour this blood and oil on the ground, let every gang-up of hell against my life and destiny be scattered by fire, in the name of Jesus.

Father, let every agent of the devil gathering anywhere to destroy the call of God upon my life be destroyed, in the name of Jesus.

Father, as I pour this blood and oil on the ground, arise and scatter every association of the dark world against my destiny, in the name of Jesus.

Father, let the fire of the Holy Ghost consume every witchcraft coven where evil gathering is currently taking place against the breakthrough of my life, in the name of Jesus.

Father, as I pour this blood and oil on the ground, wherever the gates of hell are gathering and ganging up against the church of Christ Jesus on earth, they shall not succeed, in the name of Jesus.

Father, let every evil gathering of the coven disappear as they hear the command of the voice of the Lord, in the name of Jesus.

Father, as I pour this blood and oil on the ground, I decree that every gathering place of evil men and women against my life and destiny be consumed by fire, in the name of Jesus.

Father, by the authority of the word, I send hail stones into the coven of witches where they gather to destroy the destiny of the children of God, in the name of Jesus.

Father, by Your word, disappoint the devices of evil gatherers and do not allow them to perform their enterprise, in the name of Jesus.

Father, as I pour this blood and oil on the ground, arise in Your wrath and scatter every stronghold of the kingdom of darkness militating against my destiny, in the name of Jesus.

Father, I release fire and brimstone into the camp of every strongman or woman gathering anywhere to derail the purpose of God for my life and destiny, in the name of Jesus.

Father, every gang-up of evil men and women against me and my family is hereby declared null and void, in the name of Jesus.

Father, as I pour this blood and oil on the ground, every evil gathering of men against the success of me and my family is hereby declared unfruitful, in the name of Jesus.

Father, I release the sulphur of heaven upon every evil marauder gathering to hurt the children of God, in the name of Jesus.

Father, as I pour this blood and oil on the ground, I command every meeting organized by the agents of the devil against me to meet the fire of God and be consumed, in the name of Jesus.

Father, as I pour this blood and oil on the ground, every gathering of the gods of the land to access the glory and success of the children of God is hereby met with the hail stones of death, in the name of Jesus.

Father, release Your angels to go on rampage and destroy every evil gathering against my breakthroughs in life, in the name of Jesus.

Father, let every evil gathering of wickedness against the children of God be met with divine judgment, in the name of Jesus.

Father, as I pour this blood and oil on the ground, let every evil gathering of wicked men and women against the glory of the saint meet its waterloo by the power of God, in the mighty name of Jesus.

Father, break into pieces every association of the agents of wickedness against the upliftment of my life, in the name of Jesus.

Father, break the backbone of every adversary gathering at any place to displace the glory of God for my life, in the name of Jesus.

Father, by Your word, I command every enemy of my life and destiny to turn back and die, in the name of Jesus.

Father, I ask the angels to intervene on my behalf and scatter the gathering of evil men and women against my marital settlement, in the name of Jesus.

Father, as I pour this blood and oil on the ground, I dissociate myself from every evil gathering I was introduced to by my forefathers, in the name of Jesus.

Father, I disentangle myself from the coven of evil gathering my forefathers were associated with, in the name of Jesus.

Father, release Your coal of fire to consume everyone attending the gathering of the wicked to destroy the destiny of the children of God, in the name of Jesus.

Father, clip the wing of every flying creature flying to the meeting of evil. May their wings be clipped forever, in the name of Jesus.

Father, by Your authority, I rain fire and brimstone upon the gathering place of witches and wizards, in the name of Jesus.

Father, let every evil gathering of the wicked not succeed, and may they never prevail over my life, in the mighty name of Jesus.

Father, as I pour this blood and oil on the ground, wherever the wicked are gathering against me and my family, rain fire upon them and cause them to flee seven directions, in the name of Jesus.

Father, I decree and declare that I am a child of God whose life is hidden with Christ in God; therefore every evil gathering against my life meets the brick wall of God and Christ, in the mighty name of Jesus.

Father, because I am the redeemed of the Lord, I am protected and covered from every evil gathering of the devil and his agents, in the name of Jesus.

Father, because I am the apple of Your eyes, any evil gathering that touches me touches the apple of Your eyes and will meet with Your anger and be destroyed, in the name of Jesus.

Father, the adversaries of the Lord shall be broken into pieces. I decree and declare that I am the redeemed child of God, and every evil gathering against me is against the Lord, and they shall all be broken into pieces, in the name of Jesus.

Father, I thank You immensely for answering my prayers and saving me from the power of the gathering of evil, in the name of Jesus. **Amen.**

### Now Pour the Blood and Oil on the Ground.

### And Read:

**Psalm 94:1–2 (KJV)**

> "O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself. Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud."

**Amen.**

declarations.text: We invite the Holy Spirit to come and take full control over our service. We call upon the Holy Spirit to lead us in our prayers tonight. Holy Spirit, teach us what to pray tonight. We invite the Spirit of the Lord in this room, in the mighty name of Jesus. We ask that His angels will ascend and descend in this place tonight. We ask that His fire surround us, in the mighty name of Jesus.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: We come against any interference, any destruction, every agenda of the wicked. We come against it by the power of the Holy Ghost. We pray that the fire of the Lord saturates this room, that the presence of the Lord fills this room.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: Let the protection of the Lord be upon us — that every power assigned to hinder this meeting or to hinder our deliverance or prayer, in the mighty name of Jesus, be destroyed by the power of the Holy Ghost. Every voice of the enemy be silenced in the midst of our praise. We declare that this meeting is covered by the blood of Jesus. We rebuke every retaliation to this prayer and to this deliverance in the mighty name of Jesus. Father, have Your way tonight. We give You all the glory in the mighty name of Jesus. Thank You, Father. In Jesus' name we have prayed, **Amen.**
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: We come with a heart of gratitude because we are well, we are fit, we can see. The Bible says in **Psalm 100:4 (KJV)**: *"Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name."* Our thanksgiving is like a spiritual key. When we thank God, He activates His presence. He secures His protection over us. He multiplies His provision around us.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: Beloved, our going out and our coming in — we give Him thanks and praise for keeping us, for watching over our family, our children.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: Let us read **Psalm 103:1–22 (KJV)** together as a family:
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: Tonight it is not by power, not by might, but by My Spirit, saith the LORD (**Zechariah 4:6 KJV**):
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: Deliverance is not a human activity. It is the Holy Ghost's operation. It is the Holy Ghost's power. It is the Holy Ghost that touches you.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: The fresh move of the Holy Ghost — we invite Him to come and take full control over this deliverance prayer, over our atmosphere, over your houses. In the mighty name of Jesus, let the Holy Ghost silence any other entity. Silence any adverse spirit. Silence any serpent spirit, Leviathan spirit. Let the Holy Ghost fight every entity that is fighting your life. In the mighty name of Jesus, we call upon the Spirit of the Lord to come and lead our prayers tonight, to come and direct our word, our action, our declarations. We call upon the fire of the Holy Ghost to fall upon this place, to fill our atmosphere.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: The spirit of Leviathan leads to quarrels, separation, and isolation. He operates in marriages, twisting communications, causing accusations and misunderstanding. Between friends, even at the workplace. The spirit of Leviathan destroys marriages and friendships.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: Beloved, by the time you realize it, every friend you have a problem with, every man you have a problem with, every woman you are arguing with — there is always some misunderstanding. It gets to a point in the relationship where something happens. You will know when you have encountered this type of discouragement in your life.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: Discern the presence of these water spirits and become equipped with spiritual warfare strategy to defeat them in the mighty name of Jesus. Otherwise, people might look at you funny. People might say you have mental health issues. People might say you are quarrelsome, argumentative, annoying — because when these spirits attack you, you are not aware. You cannot control your anger.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: The spirit of Leviathan is not an ordinary spirit. It is a marine spirit, a serpentine spirit, a twisting power. In many deliverance settings it is known to operate through pride, arrogance, twisting of words, misunderstanding, and confusion.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: Leviathan is a powerful, stubborn, and untouchable spirit without divine intervention. In **Isaiah 27:1 (KJV)**:
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: God Himself fights and destroys the spirit of Leviathan from your life. Beloved, this spirit twists the meaning of words and seeks to destroy the unity of people.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: - It works to hinder your spiritual growth. You are in church every day, you are reading the Bible, but you cannot understand anything. You cannot pray. You feel tormented when you take the Bible.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: - It fosters an atmosphere of accusation against you at all times.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: - Many people link this spirit to insomnia and challenges with focus.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: **Its purpose:** This spirit will try to destroy you and make you fall into sin. It will hinder your prayer life. It tries to make you fall asleep while reading the Bible. It will not allow you to submit to those in authority because it works through the spirit of pride. In many marriages we have found the spirit of Leviathan operating to cause separation and divorce.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: This is the spirit after some men or women who will beat you to the point that you are dying — your face swollen — and later they say something took over them; they went blank, the spirit took over. This spirit can make you angry. Some people have religious anger that cannot be controlled — that is the spirit of Leviathan.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: **Proverbs 16:18 (KJV)**:
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: There will be hindrances that stop you from receiving deliverance from Leviathan: sin, ungodly soul ties, occultism, fear, embarrassment, unbelief, unclean spirits on saved souls, unforgiveness, lack of knowledge, and rejection. Some people will not receive deliverance from Leviathan because his kingdom is protected by his scales.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: Leviathan is an oppression, a spirit of pride. You find it so difficult to say "I am wrong" so that you can apologize and move on. You have a sickness that moves when receiving prayer — you ask for prayer for your back and the pain shifts to another part of your body. The migraine is gone but now you have a stomach pain. The stomach pain is gone, but now you have a severe back pain. You believe you are healed but the ailment returns repeatedly.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan

declarations.text: When you are delivered from this spirit, it becomes easier to read the Bible and stay awake during services. Healing and relief of pain is your portion. If this spirit leaves your household, you and your partner, your children become at peace. A lot of families that are not talking to one another, a lot of families in argument — it is this spirit that operates in them.
declarations.teaching_title: Deliverance from the Spirit of Leviathan
